rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when a product, software release, or other thing is formally introduced to the public.

example.english: This new phone will officially debut next month.
example.traditional: 呢款新手機下個月正式推出。
example.jyutping: ne1 fun2 san1 sau2 gei1 haa6 go3 jyut6 zing3 sik1 teoi1 ceot1

rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice for a performer's debut when they enter public professional activity, especially in entertainment or sport.

example.english: They made their debut with this drama.
example.jyutping: keoi5 pang4 nei1 tou3 kek6 zing3 sik1 ceot1 dou6

rows.note: Use this for a film's first public screening rather than for a performer's first performance.

example.english: This film will have its debut in cinemas next week.
example.traditional: 呢套戲下個禮拜喺戲院首映。
example.jyutping: ne1 tou3 hei3 haa6 go3 lai5 baai3 hai2 hei3 jyun2 sau2 jing2

rows.note: Use this for the first public performance of a play, opera, musical work, dance, or other live performing-arts piece.

example.english: This play will make its debut in Hong Kong tonight.
example.traditional: 呢齣舞台劇今晚喺香港首演。
example.jyutping: ne1 ceot1 mou5 toi1 kek6 gam1 maan1 hai2 hoeng1 gong2 sau2 jin2

rows.note: Use this when a person makes a debut by entering show business or another professional career.

example.english: They made their debut at sixteen and are now famous across the city.
example.traditional: 佢十六歲就出道，依家已經紅遍全城。
example.jyutping: keoi5 sap6 luk6 seoi3 zau6 ceot1 dou6 ji1 gaa1 ji5 ging1 hung4 pin3 cyun4 sing4

rows.note: Use this for a person's or product's first public appearance when the career-entry meaning of 出道 does not apply.

example.english: This new robot vacuum will make its debut at next month's exhibition.
example.traditional: 呢部新型掃地機械人將於下月展覽會首次亮相。
example.jyutping: ne1 bou6 san1 jing4 sou3 dei6 gei1 haai6 jan4 zoeng1 jyu1 haa6 jyut6 zin2 laam5 wui2 sau2 ci3 loeng6 soeng3
